note: NECO Financial Accounting round 4 (Round 24 top-up): sales and purchases ledger control accounts, schedules of balances, discounts allowed, contra entries, errors of commission, principle, reversal and omission, suspense account corrections, journal narrations, FIFO and LIFO, average cost N25, stock value N3,000, lower of cost and NRV, disposal accounts, net book value N40,000, disposal profit N10,000, trade-in allowances, provision for doubtful debts N4,000 with N1,000 increase, bad debts recovered, prepayment N6,000, accrual N9,000, VAT at 5% (N2,000), input vs output VAT and N3,000 remit, departmental accounts and rent by floor space. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-3, WAEC Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
